game.title: Minnesota Vikings at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

lede: Tampa Bay Buccaneers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#21 in EPA per play), while Minnesota Vikings owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#1 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tampa Bay Buccaneers +0.8 with a fair total of 41.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tampa Bay Buccaneers pass offence vs Minnesota Vikings pass defence, which sits −0.292 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Minnesota Vikings and Tampa Bay Buccaneers have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
